en: A black-and-white image depicting a church with a central bell tower topped by a cross. The building features arched windows and a tiled roof with a clock visible on the tower. In front of the church, there is a tree-lined street with a cylindrical advertising column (Litfaßsäule) covered in posters. A few people in early 20th-century attire are visible walking on the street. The overall scene suggests a European town or city with historical architecture.
